headings: [Salesforce Overall](rn_general.md "Learn about new features and enhancements that affect your Salesforce experience overall.")
[Agentforce & Einstein](rn_einstein.md "Supercharge your workforce efficiency with predictive and generative AI.")

[Analytics](rn_analytics.md "Analytics enhancements include new and updated features for Tableau Next, Lightning reports and dashboards, Data 360 reports and dashboards, CRM Analytics, Intelligent apps, and Tableau.")

[Automation](rn_automate.md "Compose intelligent workflows with Flow Builder and Flow Orchestration. Integrate across any system with Flow Integration. Get help from AI to optimize and automate your supply chain business processes with Agentforce Supply Chain.")
[Commerce](rn_commerce.md "Commerce enhancements include features for B2C Commerce, B2B Commerce, Omnichannel Inventory, and Order Management.")

[Customization](rn_customization.md "Complete Setup tasks more efficiently with the help of an AI assistant with Setup with Agentforce (beta). Import and export translation files more easily with enhancements to the Translation Workbench.")

[Data 360](rn_c360_truth.md "Data 360 features and changes are released as often as monthly, so check back again soon for the latest solutions. Changes included in the Spring 2026 release are generally listed under February.")
[Deployment](rn_deployment.md "Whether you’re an admin using point-and-click tools or a developer writing code, these enhancements help you deploy your changes to a target org.")

[Development](rn_development.md "Whether you’re using Lightning components, Visualforce, Apex, or Salesforce APIs with your favorite programming language, these enhancements help you develop amazing applications, integrations, and packages for resale to other organizations.")

[Experience Cloud](rn_experiences.md "Make your Aura and LWR site pages more discoverable to AI-powered search engines and improve the precision of AI-generated answers with generative engine optimization. Create richer HTML content for Aura and LWR sites and enjoy greater design flexibility on LWR sites with expanded HTML allowlists and more readily available standard LWR components. Updates to Salesforce files make it easier for users to manage, delete, upload, and download files. The ability to create custom property types and editors for Aura and LWR sites is now generally available.")
[Field Service](rn_fieldservice.md "See what’s new in Agentforce Field Service, formerly Field Service, to help your team deliver on performance and customer service.")

[Hyperforce](rn_hyperforce.md "Products and features from Data 360, Marketing Cloud, Platform, MuleSoft, and Tableau Cloud are now available in more Hyperforce regions. Hyperforce Assistant introduced a new way to find hard-coded references. The Hyperforce public IP ranges now include addresses for inbound connections, in addition to existing outbound addresses. Prepare for IPv6 if you use IP allowlists.")
[Industries](rn_industries.md "Learn about new features and enhancements across the Industries clouds.")

[Marketing](rn_marketing_parent.md "Personalize every moment of engagement across the customer lifecycle and drive growth for your business with the latest features and enhancements from Salesforce Marketing apps.")

[MuleSoft](rn_mulesoft.md "Use the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform suite of products to connect and integrate apps, systems, and data across your enterprise. Streamline operations by building and automating processes with clicks instead of code. You can design, develop, govern, and share APIs and integration apps and host them in the cloud or on-premises.")

[Mobile](rn_mobile.md "The Salesforce mobile app now uses single sign-on for faster logins and notifications that lets you work on tasks. Create mobile and offline ready Lightning Web components with Mobile MCP tools.")

[Omnistudio](rn_omnistudio.md "Validate your workflows built with Omniscripts and Flexcards end-to-end by using the UI Test Automation Model (UTAM) framework. For a fast, scalable experience, add Omnscripts and Flexcards to Lightning Web Runtime (LWR) Experience Cloud sites (pilot). Get immediate help with an Omnistudio component or element with the Omnistudio Assistance AI Agent (pilot). With accessibility improvements for Omniscripts and Flexcards, create inclusive workflows and solutions for customers and users with disabilities. Filter empty records in Omnistudio Data Mapper Extract and Turbo Extract components with the Is Null operator.")

[Partner Cloud](rn_partner_cloud.md "Start managing the full partner lifecycle in one place with tools built directly into Salesforce. Use Partner Cloud to recruit, onboard, enable, and co-sell with partners while giving them secure access to the data and workflows they need. Bring together key capabilities like deal registration, incentives, training, and performance tracking so your team can scale indirect sales and improve partner relationships. Partner Cloud helps you do more with the partners you already have—faster, and with less manual work.")
[Revenue Management](rn_revenue.md "Learn about new features and enhancements for Agentforce Revenue Management.")

[Sales](rn_sales.md "Learn about the latest features and updates to grow your pipeline and increase the efficiency of your sales teams. Sales Cloud is now Agentforce Sales. You may see references to Sales Cloud in our application and documentation.")

[Salesforce CMS](rn_cms.md "Previously known as Sidebar Extensions, Extensions in CMS have an improved development workflow. Build extensions to add more productivity tools to your CMS content workflow, such as third-party generative AI tools or tone and grammar editors. When you work with external content providers, you can now choose which providers are available to your workspace and where to save files from these systems.")

[Security, Identity, and Privacy](rn_security.md "Redirections end for legacy host names, including instanced host names in API calls. Connected app creation is disabled by default for all Salesforce orgs. Salesforce Backup & Recover is now a native app. And, Privacy Requests fulfill your customers' Right to Be Forgotten requests.")

[Service](rn_service.md "Service Cloud is now Agentforce Service. You may see references to Service Cloud in our application and documentation. Learn about the latest features from Service to supercharge productivity across your organization. Service features are released as often as monthly, so check here for the latest information.")
